import numpy as np
idx=np.argsort(P)
print(np.c_[t,P,dP_dt][:15])
print(np.corrcoef(np.c_[t,P,dP_dt].T))
print(t.min(),t.max(),P.min(),P.max(),dP_dt.min(),dP_dt.max())

best=[]
for b in np.linspace(0.05,6,600):
    X=np.c_[t*np.sin(b*P), np.log(1+P)**2, np.ones_like(P)]
    coef,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-X@coef
    best.append((np.sum(r**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2),b,coef))
best.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
for x in best[:5]: print(x)

def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0]*t*np.sin(params[1]*P) + params[2]*np.log(1+P)**2 + params[3]/P
